keySentence: I think love is what makes us truly real.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: We finished all the stories. Love was the biggest lesson. Love makes us truly real. I think love is what makes us truly real.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Congratulations on finishing all the Grade 3 stories. From Peter Rabbit to the Velveteen Rabbit, we learned so much. I think love is what makes us truly real in this world. Every story showed us that love, courage, and kindness matter. The velveteen rabbit became real because of a boy's love. Let us remember that true love is the greatest magic of all.
facts.Word cards: real = 진짜의 / love = 사랑 / can = ~할 수 있다 / make = 만들다 / happen = 일어나다
